name: Drinking Water
description:
A pint of the inn's drinking water, brought to the table in a clean serving vessel. The price covers service; no container is sold with it.

One purchase supplies one pint of prepared drink. The inn retains its serving vessel; takeaway requires your own suitable container. This drink grants no automatic healing or other bonus.

weight.notes: Contents-only weight of one pint of prepared drink, using the project liquid allowance of 1 lb per pint (small spirit measures rounded to 0.06 lb). The inn retains its vessel; carried containers weigh separately.

source.title: Devil's Table: Goods & Provisions
source.reference: Original Tavern recipe, description, portion, project price and adjusted weight. Mundane food/drink only; 2014 rules baseline. See docs/TAVERN_REVIEW.md.

use.condition: Use only after the whole sale unit is consumed. Track partial use, preparation and any remaining packaging manually; no healing or status effects are applied.
